config.footerNote: Questions are original practice items written around the common GCSE-style language themes (People and lifestyle; Popular culture; Communication and the world around us). They are not official past-paper or mark-scheme material, and model answers are indicative exemplars only. This app has no audio, so Listening items are written transcripts.

Paper 1.Listen and answer: AO1 (Listening): marks are awarded for accurate, relevant comprehension of the spoken/written Russian. Partial credit is given for identifying the correct detail even if the English expression is imperfect; answers must match what is stated, not inferred beyond the text.

Paper 2.Describe the photo: AO2 (Speaking): assessed on communication of relevant content, range and accuracy of language, and pronunciation/intonation. Higher marks require description plus opinion plus justification, not description alone.
Paper 2.Role-play: AO2 (Speaking): assessed on task completion (all bullet points covered), appropriateness of response, and ability to deal with an unpredictable question. Accuracy and spontaneity are credited over complexity.

Paper 3.Reading comprehension: AO3 (Reading): marks for accurate extraction of explicit and implicit meaning from the Russian text; answers must be supported by the text and expressed clearly in English.
Paper 3.Translate into English: AO3 (Reading)/translation: marked for accuracy of meaning first, then grammatical accuracy of the English produced; omissions and mistranslations of tense/negatives lose marks.

Paper 4.Translate into Russian: AO4 (Writing)/translation: marked on accuracy of meaning and of Russian grammar (verb endings, agreement, word order); partial credit is given per correctly translated sense unit.
Paper 4.Write in Russian: AO4 (Writing): assessed on content (covering all bullet points), range of vocabulary/structures, accuracy, and quality of opinions with justification. Using a range of tenses accurately accesses higher marks.
